hooks.name: Keep PROJECT-STATE.md live after every change
hooks.description: After any agent turn that made a meaningful change, fix, or decision in the workspace, refresh PROJECT-STATE.md so it stays a true live picture of the project. Covers all changes, not only spec-task completions.

action.prompt:
The agent turn just ended. Decide whether this turn made a meaningful change, fix, or strategic decision to the project (code edits, config/migration/CI changes, a resolved bug, a design/architecture decision, a dependency or stack change, a spec task completed, or a live-cloud action). If it did NOT (pure Q&A, read-only investigation, or no durable change), do nothing and stop.

If it DID, update PROJECT-STATE.md at the repo root so it remains a true, live picture anyone (including Kiro cold) can read. Rules:

- Machine-managed STATE block: edit ONLY the lines between '<!-- BEGIN STATE -->' and '<!-- END STATE -->'. Keep the exact three-line format the Living-Docs Writer uses: '- **Phase:**', '- **Updated:**' (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD), and '- **Summary:**'. This is the one-line "where we are right now".
- Prose outside the markers (sections like Stack, Code map, Spec completion status, Strategic decisions, Obstacles / open risks, Immediate next steps): update the sections the change actually affects. This is the durable "how and why". Add a bullet for a new decision; move a closed item out of the open/obstacles list; correct anything the change made stale.
- Be concise and strictly factual. Do not invent progress not reflected in the code, specs, or this turn's actions. Distinguish locally-verified work from live-cloud claims.
- Never write any secret value, key, token, or JWT into the file — reference credentials by name only.
- Kill-gate PASS/CUT verdicts go in RESEARCH-LOG.md via the Living-Docs Writer's append path, NEVER in PROJECT-STATE.md. Do not touch LESSONS.md (hand-authored constraints).
- Make the edits and stop; do not run builds, tests, or commits.
